summary: FMC Corporation filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, disclosing a framework agreement to sell its property in Newark, Delaware to Ercor Elkton, LLC for gross cash proceeds of approximately $114 million. The deal involves underutilized buildings and land at its Stine Research Center. FMC intends to lease back the facilities it actively operates. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or named advisors. The transaction is subject to due diligence and closing conditions. It is expected to close in Q4 2026, with proceeds used to pay down debt. Key risks include potential renegotiation during due diligence and the preliminary nature of the leaseback agreement.
